title: Diameter of Binary Tree
contract: Return the number of edges in the longest simple path; an empty tree has diameter 0.
reasoning: At every node, recompute left and right subtree heights and compare their sum with child diameters.
Postorder can return a height to the parent while updating the best diameter seen anywhere.
A path through a node uses leftHeight+rightHeight edges when height counts nodes. Return only one branch upward because a path cannot fork when extended through its parent.
